title: Appraisal-Based Payoff Thresholds and Outcomes — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction
content:
Payoff and Loan Satisfaction plans that settle a loan for less than its balance, or that end it through a sale, rest on the as-is appraised value and on the outcome settings below.

| Setting | Borrower Voluntary Payoff | HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff | Heir Retention Payoff | Estate Market Sale Payoff | Approved Short Sale Payoff | Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Percent of the as-is appraised value that, when lower than the balance, satisfies the loan for a retaining successor | 0.00 | 0.00 | 95 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Percent of the as-is appraised value the contract price must reach, when lower than the balance, for a market sale to satisfy the loan | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 95 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Lowest contract price, as a percent of the as-is appraised value, Cedarline approves for a short sale | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 88 | 0.00 |
| A current as-is appraisal from the maturity case is needed to set the terms | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Any part of the balance above the required payoff is forgiven and never collected | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Sale proceeds above the balance are released to the estate | no | no | no | yes | no | no |
| Business days after satisfaction within which a surplus is released to the estate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 | 0 | 0 |
| The satisfied loan proceeds to an FHA insurance claim rather than a paid-in-full status | no | no | no | no | yes | yes |

A percentage shown as 0.00 means the plan has no such percentage test.

### Questions this schedule answers

**On which plan does a retaining successor settle at a share of the appraised value?** On the Heir Retention Payoff, where the share is 95 percent of the as-is appraised value whenever that amount is lower than the balance.

**Which plans forgive what the payoff leaves unpaid?** The Heir Retention Payoff, the Estate Market Sale Payoff, the Approved Short Sale Payoff and the Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure; the Borrower Voluntary Payoff and the HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff forgive nothing.

**Where does a surplus go?** Only the Estate Market Sale Payoff releases proceeds above the balance to the estate, within 10 business days after satisfaction.

### Hypothetical illustration

On a hypothetical as-is appraised value of USD 200000.00, 95 percent is USD 190000.00 and 88 percent is USD 176000.00. The appraised value is invented for the illustration and is not any property's value.
